summary: Lyko Group AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells various hair care and beauty products in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, Germany, Austria, Poland, and the Netherlands. The company retails gift sets; hair products comprising hair care, styling, hair accessories, hair color, styling tools, brushes and combs, and hair extensions; skincare products consisting of face, skin condition, body, suncare, beauty tech, professional skincare, and dermatological skincare products; makeup products, such as cleansers, face, eyes, lips, makeup brushes, palettes, tools and accessories, and SFX makeup; fragrances, including perfume, body mist, and deodorants; and K-beauty products. It also provides health and wellness products comprising supplements, training and health, food and beverages, sex and pleasure, and oral hygiene products; beard products for men; kids' products; jewelry; home and spa items; phone accessories; underwear; and travel products. The company sells its products through its sales teams, physical stores and salons, online through Lyko.com, and the Lyko app. It also provides haircuts, styling, and skincare treatment services. Lyko Group AB (publ) was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Vansbro, Sweden.
